result.instructions: Tools for AgencyBloc, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the individual named Maria Lopez and show her policies."; "Which policies were submitted in the last 14 days and what are their carriers?"; "List the open activities on group 48213 and add a note that the renewal quote was sent.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes AgencyBloc data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run agencybloc_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run agencybloc_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run agencybloc_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. agencybloc_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: agencybloc_search_individuals
tools.title: Search individuals
tools.description: Search individuals (clients and contacts) in AgencyBloc. All filters are optional and combine; with none you get the first records. Returns id, name, email, birth date, phones and last-updated time (national ids such as SSN are never returned). Use updated_since to find recently changed people. POST individuals/search.

phone.description: Matches the home, cell or business phone.

updated_since.description: Only records updated on/after this (inclusive); results then run oldest update first.

limit.description: Most records to return, 1-500 (default 50). There is no paging: narrow with filters if more may exist.

tools.name: agencybloc_get_individual
tools.title: Get individual
tools.description: One individual by id, with addresses, policies and custom fields (and activities when include_activities is true). National ids are removed. POST individuals/detail.

tools.name: agencybloc_search_groups
tools.title: Search groups
tools.description: Search groups (employer / business accounts) in AgencyBloc by name, type or phone. Returns id, name, type and phone. POST groups/search.

type.description: The group type as configured in the account.

updated_since.description: Only groups modified on/after this date.

limit.description: Most records to return, 1-500 (default 50). There is no paging: narrow with filters if more may exist.

tools.name: agencybloc_get_group
tools.title: Get group
tools.description: One group by id, with addresses, policies and custom fields (and activities when include_activities is true). POST groups/detail.

tools.name: agencybloc_search_policies
tools.title: Search policies
tools.description: Search policies by number, coverage type, carrier, holder, servicing agent, application date or last update. Returns id, holder, policy number, carrier, status, coverage type, effective and renewal dates. Use submitted_after/updated_since for recent business. POST policies/search.

coverage_type.description: Coverage type as configured in the account (e.g. Medicare Supplement).

entity_id.description: Holder id (group or individual id); give entity_type too.

entity_type.description: Whether entity_id is a Group or an Individual.

submitted_before.description: Application submitted on/before this date (AgencyBloc includes the date itself).

updated_since.description: Only records updated on/after this (inclusive); results then run oldest update first.

limit.description: Most records to return, 1-500 (default 50). There is no paging: narrow with filters if more may exist.

tools.name: agencybloc_get_policy
tools.title: Get policy
tools.description: One policy by id: holder, agent, carrier, status, dates, premium, coverages and custom fields. POST policies/detail.

tools.name: agencybloc_search_agents
tools.title: Search agents
tools.description: Search agents (producers) by name, email or phone. Returns id, name, email and phones. POST agents/search.

phone.description: Matches the home, cell or business phone.

limit.description: Most records to return, 1-500 (default 50). There is no paging: narrow with filters if more may exist.

tools.name: agencybloc_get_agent
tools.title: Get agent
tools.description: One agent by id, with agencies, addresses and custom fields (and activities when include_activities is true). POST agents/detail.

tools.name: agencybloc_search_carriers
tools.title: Search carriers
tools.description: Search insurance carriers by name or phone. Returns id, name, abbreviation and phones. POST carriers/search.

limit.description: Most records to return, 1-500 (default 50). There is no paging: narrow with filters if more may exist.

tools.name: agencybloc_list_activities
tools.title: List activities of a record
tools.description: All activities (tasks, calls, renewals) logged on one group, individual, agent, carrier or lead: date, subject, notes, status, type, method, priority and follow-up. There is no paging. POST activities/list.

tools.name: agencybloc_get_activities
tools.title: Get activities by id
tools.description: Activities by id (1-50 ids), e.g. the ids shown on a policy or individual. POST activity/list.

tools.name: agencybloc_list_notes
tools.title: List notes of a record
tools.description: Notes (subject, body, author, dates, pinned flag, attachment names) on one agent, group, individual or policy, newest change first. There is no paging. POST notes/list.

tools.name: agencybloc_search_leads_by_phone
tools.title: Search sales records (leads) by phone
tools.description: Find Sales Enablement records (leads) by phone number; the search is by phone only. Only accounts with the Sales Enablement module have them. POST salesEnablement/leads/searchphone.

tools.name: agencybloc_get_lead
tools.title: Get sales record (lead)
tools.description: One Sales Enablement record (lead) by record id. POST salesEnablement/Leads/detail.

tools.name: agencybloc_create_individual
tools.title: Create individual
tools.description: WRITE: create a new individual (client or contact) in AgencyBloc. Needs first and last name; everything else is optional. It does not check for duplicates: search first. Returns the new individualID. POST individuals/create.

status.description: Status as configured in the account; an unknown value is created.

type.description: Type as configured in the account; an unknown value is created.

tags.description: Tags (replaces existing tags on update; an empty string clears them).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the exact custom field NAME configured in AgencyBloc (sent as custom_<name>). Separate several values of a checkbox-list field with ||.

address_type.description: Address label (e.g. Home, Business, Mailing); used with the address fields below.

tools.name: agencybloc_update_individual
tools.title: Update individual
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing individual; fields you leave out are not sent. Tags are replaced (empty string clears them). Addresses are not changed here. Returns the individualID. POST individuals/update.

status.description: Status as configured in the account; an unknown value is created.

type.description: Type as configured in the account; an unknown value is created.

tags.description: Tags (replaces existing tags on update; an empty string clears them).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the exact custom field NAME configured in AgencyBloc (sent as custom_<name>). Separate several values of a checkbox-list field with ||.

tools.name: agencybloc_create_group
tools.title: Create group
tools.description: WRITE: create a new group (employer / business account) in AgencyBloc. It does not check for duplicates: search first. Returns the new groupID. POST groups/create.

type.description: Group type as configured in the account.

account_manager.description: A user id or the exact user name in AgencyBloc.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the exact custom field NAME configured in AgencyBloc (sent as custom_<name>). Separate several values of a checkbox-list field with ||.

address_type.description: Address label (e.g. Home, Business, Mailing); used with the address fields below.

tools.name: agencybloc_update_group
tools.title: Update group
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing group (including its name); fields you leave out are not sent. Returns the groupID. POST groups/update.

type.description: Group type as configured in the account.

account_manager.description: A user id or the exact user name in AgencyBloc.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the exact custom field NAME configured in AgencyBloc (sent as custom_<name>). Separate several values of a checkbox-list field with ||.

tools.name: agencybloc_create_policy
tools.title: Create policy
tools.description: WRITE: create a policy on an existing group or individual. Needs the holder (entity_id + entity_type), coverage type, status and the carrier's full name; unknown coverage types / statuses are created in the account. Returns the new policyID. POST policies/create.

entity_id.description: The groupID or individualID that holds the policy.

pay_frequency.description: Payment frequency as configured in the account (e.g. Monthly).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the exact custom field NAME configured in AgencyBloc (sent as custom_<name>). Separate several values of a checkbox-list field with ||.

tools.name: agencybloc_update_policy
tools.title: Update policy
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing policy (status, carrier, dates, premium ...); fields you leave out are not sent. Returns the policyID. POST policies/update.

pay_frequency.description: Payment frequency as configured in the account (e.g. Monthly).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the exact custom field NAME configured in AgencyBloc (sent as custom_<name>). Separate several values of a checkbox-list field with ||.

tools.name: agencybloc_create_activity
tools.title: Create activity
tools.description: WRITE: log an activity (call, task, renewal reminder) on a group, individual, agent, carrier or lead. Status, type, method and priority are the text values of the account's dropdowns (My Agency Settings > Data Administration); unknown values are created. When the status is not Complete the activity is a follow-up: give follow_up_user_id and follow_up_date (and start/end times), and AgencyBloc assigns it to that user. Nothing is sent to the customer. Activities cannot be edited or deleted through the API. Returns the new activityID. POST activities/create.

method.description: Activity method, e.g. Phone or Email.

related_policy_id.description: A policy of this group or individual.

follow_up_user_id.description: AgencyBloc user the follow-up is assigned to.

tools.name: agencybloc_create_note
tools.title: Add note
tools.description: WRITE: add one note (subject + body) to an agent, group, individual or policy. AgencyBloc never allows notes to be edited or deleted through the API (audit rule), so the note is permanent. Pinning a note unpins the previously pinned one. Returns the new note id. POST notes/create.

pinned.description: Pin the note (unpins any other pinned note). Default false.
